Interface UDFDataFillJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<UDFDataFill>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>
public interface UDFDataFillJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<UDFDataFill, UDFDataFill.UDFDataFillKey>
Repository of the fill state of the cells of user-defined security fields. Rows are written only by UDFFillWriter; the queries here read them and the values and scope they are compared with.

    • deleteByIdUDFMetadata

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query(value="DELETE FROM udf_data_fill WHERE id_udf_metadata = ?1", nativeQuery=true) int deleteByIdUDFMetadata(Integer idUDFMetadata)
      Deletes every fill row of a field, used when its fill source is switched to manual. The values stay in udf_data and are manual from then on.
      Parameters:
      idUDFMetadata - the field
      Returns:
      the number of deleted rows

    • getTenantScopeSecurityIds

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) List<Integer> getTenantScopeSecurityIds(Integer idTenant)
      Returns the IDs of the securities of the tenant scope: every security in a watchlist of the tenant and every security referenced by a transaction of the tenant, including closed positions and inactive instruments. Private securities of other tenants are excluded. The asset classes of a field are not applied here. Named query: UDFDataFill.getTenantScopeSecurityIds
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the home tenant of the owner of the field
      Returns:
      the distinct security IDs, ascending

    • getFieldValuesOfUser

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) List<UDFDataFillJpaRepository.IdEntityValue> getFieldValuesOfUser(Integer idUser, Integer idUDFMetadata)
      Returns the non-null values of one field of a user, read with JSON_VALUE from the udf_data rows of the entity Security. With user 0 this reads a system-wide field such as the persisted Yahoo symbol. Named query: UDFDataFill.getFieldValuesOfUser
      Parameters:
      idUser - the owner of the udf_data rows
      idUDFMetadata - the field, read as JSON key f<idUDFMetadata>
      Returns:
      per security the value as text
